content: Bepaŋ wou nintilooŋ niutumba diniŋ kap
Metam didimehi, hidi Yahwedi nemenemek hogohogok tuguk wendok nadifo tineŋ. Metam Bepaŋ’walaŋ medeŋiŋ didimeniŋgoŋ takaliiŋdi wou nintiloune utumba hinek tilak.
Kulele ulune mede momooŋ tobune Yahwe wou niutumbaneŋ. Gita tawaŋiŋ 10 u ulune aditok mede momooŋ tomimbek.
Kap kobuli hinek tomineŋ, tiŋa gita ulune mede momooŋ hinek toneŋ, kaŋ nadifo diniŋ kakali maaŋ tineŋ.
Yahwe’walaŋ mede adi biyagoŋ hogohogok. Adi yadi titiŋ didimeniŋ titiŋdok yofafaŋeguk hogohogok u tubune folooŋnit tubu-dapmalak.
Bepaŋ adi titiŋ didimehi hogohogok eŋ yodapmaŋ didimehidok hogok yabunadifo tilak. Eŋ Yahwe’walaŋ siloŋ tobogoŋdi kwetkwet hakilidapmalak.
Yahwedi yobune kunum heki mintagiŋ, tiŋa mele muyakip eŋ bamholiŋa u adi’walaŋ maŋiŋ mede-de mintagiŋ.
Adi me niŋdi ime kabot gineŋ gilune fotokolak wondok tuwot imeŋgwaŋ hogohogok beŋa kwet kubugoŋ gineŋ bopneguk, eŋ imeŋgwaŋ fuliŋmamaŋ u henaulibi yotneŋ boihebiguk.
Kwetkwet metam hogohogok Yahwe kaŋ hehele tiŋa gikiŋgoŋ timineŋ.
Maŋgande, adigoŋ mede hogok yobune kwet i mintaguk. Tiŋa undugoŋ mede saŋiniŋnit hinek yobune nemenemek mintadapmagiŋ.
Yahwedi mebop noli’walaŋ nadihebethik u dobu-uyali tubufit tiyemilak. Tiŋa adi nemek niŋ titiŋdok mede yofolok tiiŋ u talik teheyembune tuwot mu tiiŋ.
Iŋgoŋ oŋ, Yahwe’walaŋ yohebetŋiŋ adi dapmandapmaŋnit mokit haliwooŋ halaak. Weleŋ gineŋ nadihebet hatak u meeniŋ bop indigoŋ kwetkwet hatitawiiŋ’walaŋ gineŋ folooŋ tubumintalak.
Metam adi Yahwedi Bepaŋhik hatilak, adi Bepaŋ’walaŋ kahaŋ kahileiŋ doktiŋa nadifo kedem tineŋ. Biyagoŋ hinek, metam agaŋ netok gigit yoŋa yabukahileguk adi nadifo kedem tineŋ.
Yahwe adi kunum foloŋ hali diweune foune metam kwetfoloŋhi hogohogok yabudapmalak.
Adi me mapme iit kwelineŋ ilaŋa diweune foune kwetfoloŋ metam yabudapmaŋ tilak.
Negoŋ metamdok nadinadi tubumintayemilak, tiŋa titiŋ dediŋ tiiŋ hogohogok u agaŋ yabunadidapmalak.
Me mapme niŋ adi mikmeŋiye fee hatiiŋ iŋgoŋ tuwot mu tubulodaneŋ, be mikme niŋ adi saŋiniŋŋiŋ wapum wendi tuwot mu tubulodahinakawek.
Mik wosi heki adi mikme yehitubu-lodaune mik gineŋ fafaŋe tuwot mu tineŋ. Wosi fafaŋeniŋdi mikme mik gineŋ gweheyeiŋ kotigoŋ tuwot mu yahaŋewek.
Iŋgoŋ indiŋ nadineŋ, metam nediyeŋdi Yahwedok gikiŋgoŋ timiiŋ, tiŋa welehikdi kahile hinek tiiŋ, adi yadi Yahwedi yabudokolune namanda foloŋ hatiiŋ.
Unduŋ doktiŋa yabudokoune tuwot mu kumiiŋ. Eŋ fiye kadaka nai gineŋ nanaŋedok baniŋ tiiŋ kaŋ yabudokoune kaipmuŋ hatiiŋ.
Unduŋ doktiŋa indi Yahwedi nihitubu-lodadok woomam. Adi kubugoŋdi kweletalaknik tiŋa nihitubu-loda tilak.
Indi adi wou uŋgoniŋ u nadisukilitiyam, unduŋ doktiŋa aditok nadifo timiyam.
O Yahwe, indi du nihitubu-lodaweŋ yoŋa dutok nadikunakunale hati-tiyam, ale siloŋ tobogoŋgedi indigut haliwooŋ hatuwaak.
